storage: git-versioned JSONL datacore/sentinel2/s1_chips_index.jsonl (metadata ONLY; chip binaries local under datacore/sentinel2/chips_s1/, GITIGNORED — ~1.6 MB/scene, regenerable from CDSE at ~1.12 PU/scene)
written_by: scripts/cdse_s1_chips.py (Python, session-run; never on Railway — see cot.json _note on envelope-test coverage of Python writers)
source: Discovery: Element84 earth-search STAC (anonymous, collection sentinel-1-grd). Chips: Copernicus Sentinel-1 GRD IW via Sentinel Hub Process API on CDSE (orthorectified SIGMA0_ELLIPSOID, FLOAT32 — bright double-bounce returns probed to sigma0 ~2500, integer types would clamp)
license: Copernicus free/open data policy; attribution 'Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data'

field_map.orbit_state/relative_orbit: pass geometry — the estimator conditions on orbit, never mixes geometries silently (Cushing v1: ascending/34 only)
field_map.est_pu: estimated Sentinel Hub processing units spent
field_map.bbox: chip bbox lon/lat [W,S,E,N] — IDENTICAL to the v2 optical stack (test-pinned) so the stacks stay pixel-aligned for fusion
field_map.bands: band order in the FLOAT32 TIFF (VV, VH linear sigma0)
field_map.pulled_at: acquisition timestamp UTC (month key for PU accounting)

confidence_model: RAW acquisition metadata — no derived quantities. Radar: cloud-immune, sun-independent (the v2 confound class does not exist here). Gate-1 criteria for the v3 estimator pre-stated in the TANK-FILL v3 workup (open_questions.md); until PASS nothing derived is a SIGNAL.
cadence: every IW dual-pol scene (~4-6/month: S1A + S1D, 12-day repeat each), session-run
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). Tank-fill v3 PR-1; PR-2 = double-bounce estimator + gate-1 attempt vs EIA (comparator tankfill_gate1.py reused as-is).
